sentences.text: LaKeith Lee `` Keith '' Stanfield -LRB- born August 12 , 1991 -RRB- is an American actor and rapper .

He made his feature film debut in Short Term 12 -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , for which he was nominated for an Independent Spirit Award .	Short Term 12	Short Term 12	Independent Spirit Award	Independent Spirit Award
